ABOUT THE PROJECT

Forecast the glow. Compare the sky.

Afterglow turns live weather and solar geometry into a calm, bilingual sunset forecast. Upload the real sky for a private in-browser color comparison, then optionally ask OpenAI to interpret the photo against the forecast.

  • Extracts uploaded sky colors privately in the browser for forecast comparison.
  • Adds an optional AI color story, atmospheric reading, forecast match, and photography tip.

ABOUT THE PROJECT

Make today serve the life you’re building.

Orbit is a calm, bilingual personal operating system that connects long-term direction to daily action. The iPhone app works offline first, syncs securely when enabled, and keeps AI recommendations as proposals until you approve them.

  • Connects goals, milestones, tasks, habits, and reflections through a navigable Life Graph.
  • Commits core actions to local SQLite before the interface reports success.
  • Offers optional, revision-based cloud sync through a Go and PostgreSQL backend.
  • Keeps AI approval-gated and excludes reflection content unless explicitly enabled.

ABOUT THE PROJECT

Learn from behavior. Explain every result.

Affinity makes the full recommendation loop inspectable—from versioned event ingestion and user representations to model comparison, ranking policy, and human-readable explanations. Rust owns the low-latency online path while Python owns offline learning and evaluation.

  • Trains collaborative, two-tower, and sequential recommenders against a reproducible popularity baseline.
  • Serves filtered, diversified, versioned recommendations with explanations through a Rust and Axum API.
  • Provides a Next.js research console for profiles, projections, model comparisons, and deterministic experiments.
  • Keeps operations local first with PostgreSQL durability and optional Qdrant, Redpanda, and MLflow extensions.

ABOUT THE PROJECT

Durable execution beyond the happy path.

Relay turns immutable workflow definitions into durable, inspectable runs. PostgreSQL owns the truth, NATS JetStream wakes workers, and every claim, retry, cost, trace, log, and user-visible state transition survives failure while remaining fully explainable.

  • Schedules dependency-aware DAG nodes concurrently with per-run and global limits.
  • Uses leased attempts, fencing tokens, recovery scans, and transactional claims to survive crashes and duplicate delivery.
  • Runs LLM and allowlisted MCP tool nodes with typed outputs, budgets, deadlines, and explicit permission gates.
  • Records append-only events and observable usage without claiming exactly-once external side effects.

ABOUT THE PROJECT

Vector search without the black box.

Axion delivers approximate nearest-neighbor search without hiding durability, recall, or failure semantics. Its native multilayer HNSW graph runs in Rust, RocksDB owns durable truth, and exact search remains available as a correctness oracle for every performance claim.

  • Supports cosine, Euclidean, and dot-product scoring across exact and native HNSW search.
  • Commits records through synchronous RocksDB WAL batches with deterministic graph recovery.
  • Exposes versioned Axum REST, Tonic gRPC, OpenAPI, protobuf, and synchronous or asynchronous Python clients.
  • Ships with a responsive Next.js console, Prometheus metrics, OTLP tracing, Docker, and Kubernetes deployment paths.

ABOUT THE PROJECT

Database answers teams can defend.

DataCurrent connects the complete investigation loop: real workload collection, regression detection, structured plan analysis, cited AI proposals, and isolated empirical verification. Every finding preserves the boundary between observation, heuristic, hypothesis, and measured result.

  • Surfaces workload health, expensive query fingerprints, historical latency, and provider context.
  • Investigates PostgreSQL and Snowflake through read-only plans, schema, indexes, lineage, and narrow evidence tools.
  • Uses the OpenAI Agents SDK for typed, cited, confidence-scored recommendations with explicit limitations.
  • Verifies candidates through repeated isolated benchmarks with median, p95, result digests, and visible methodology.
